frequency_question: How often do announced tariffs on major trading partners take effect as scheduled rather than being delayed or superseded by a deal?
membership_rule: Includes formal executive announcements of specific tariff rates on specific partner countries with a defined implementation date. Excludes vague exploratory statements or broad legislative proposals without executive implementation dates.
window: Within 60 to 90 days of the announcement date.

cases.name: 2019 US Threat of Tariffs on Mexico (border dispute)
2019 US Threat of Tariffs on European goods over Airbus subsidies
2025 Proposed Tariffs on Canadian and Mexican goods (early cycle threats)

coverage_note: 4 named cases representing major tariff threat cycles; historical base rate hovers around 50 percent for implementation without prior agreement.
known_gaps: Sample size is small because high-stakes proximate tariff threats are relatively infrequent.
validity_reason: Trade policy patterns remain relatively stable across administration styles over multi-year horizons.
